Securing digital assets requires strict adherence to cryptographic best practices. Leaving significant capital on unverified platforms introduces counterparty risk, making self-custody via hardware wallets the preferred method for long-term holding. Swapping network assets, trading tokens for stablecoins, and realizing capital gains typically constitute taxable events. Consult a qualified, independent tax professional in your local jurisdiction to understand exact reporting requirements rather than relying on generalized summaries.
